chapter: Banjo, piano and his own bands
title: Forming his own band with Harold Christophe and Leroy Thompson
summary: He assembled his own band with Henry Ravallon, Clarence and Harold Christophe, later adding Leroy Thompson after Blue died.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Now, he's got a banjo in the museum right now. His wife thinks that's his banjo. That wasn't his. That's his friend of mine's banjo. He borrowed it. You see, when I got to playing regular, I had a band. I made a band of my own. Me, who I had, Henry Ravallon. I had Clarence, and I got some guy's name, played the same beef right tenor. Christophe. Yeah, Harold Christophe. Harold Christophe. And I was playing the banjo. And who was somebody else again? And then after that, I got this guy to play with me. When Lawrence was playing one time, Lawrence told me, when he got sick, he couldn't play no more. And I got blue. Blue died. I had to get somebody else. So I got Leroy. You know Leroy? Leroy Thompson? They called him Leroy Thompson? Yeah, Leroy Thompson. I got him to play with me. He was playing with me from the last. And he sings and he plays. That's how I was out there.
